entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Breakpoint triggers watchdog timeout on MacCatalyst/iOS #117352
  • [API Proposal]: SortedSet<T> Nearest Element APIs - `GetLowerThan`, `GetLowerThanEqualTo`, `GetHigherThanEqualTo`, `GetHigherThan` #117349
  • Error in aot publisshed app with library https://github.com/dahall/taskscheduler #117348
  • [API Proposal]: ConcurrentDictionary GetOrAdd with condition #117343

Closed

  • `AVX512F.Compare()` not accelerated on xarch #96414
    10.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: Add dot product intrinsics to AVX10v2 API #110032
  • Different Behavior between .NET and .NET Mono when entering Try Block with Non-Zero Stack Height #117335
  • Why it won't work on macOS 15.0 #108390
    10.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Improve gtDispConst for CNS_STR #117350
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Ensure hardware intrinsic tests are marked with [Fact] #117347
    needs-area-label
  • [NativeAOT] Split `ExternSymbolNode` into two types for data and functions #117346
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Do not preserve enumerators in reflection #117345
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • [NativeAOT] Cleanup usages of LowLevelDictionary #117344
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Optimize Queue<T>.Enumerator #117341
    area-System.Collections
  • Remove pinning from frozen objects (strings, arrays, ..) #117340
    area-CodeGen-coreclr

Merged

  • Seal NullLogger #117342
    area-Extensions-Logging, 10.0.0

Updated

  • Add CPUID for AvxVnniInt8 and AvxVnniInt16 #113956
    area-System.Runtime.Intrinsics, linkable-framework, community-contribution
  • Skip null loggers when creating message loggers in Logger factory. #117334
    area-Extensions-Logging, community-contribution
  • Fix `File.Exists` for pipe paths on Windows #117333
    area-System.IO, community-contribution
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 679: Build ID 2744023 #115228
    area-Infrastructure-libraries, linkable-framework
  • Misc. illumous build fixes (prereq. for #105403) #117023
    arch-x64, area-Infrastructure-coreclr, os-SunOS, community-contribution
  • Constant fold dictionary lookup #117332
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • JIT: relax another check in conditional escape analysis #117295
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Allow NecessaryTypeSymbol in generic dictionaries #117315
    area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Use `$NOCANCEL` variants of APIs on apple platforms #117330
    area-PAL-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Instrumentation for #116276 #116411
